item.title: Today in Black History: February 26th
item.description: 1926 – Theodore Flowers Becomes Middleweight Boxing Champion On this day in 1926, Theodore “Tiger” Flowers defeats Harry Greb in a boxing match at Madison Square Garden, becoming the first African American middleweight champion in boxing history. item.title: Lee Edna McFadden Grantonz
item.description: Lee Edna McFadden Grantonz, affectionately known as “Little Bit” and Mother Grantonz, passed on January 30, 2026.
